bio.text: Monique Chandler-Waterman represents the 58th Assembly District in Brooklyn, which includes East Flatbush, parts of Canarsie, Brownsville and Crown Heights.
She was elected to the Assembly in a May 2022 special election to succeed Nick Perry, after his appointment as U.S. Ambassador to Jamaica.
Earlier she was Outreach Director for New York City's Test & Trace Corps and directed community outreach for then-City Council Member Jumaane Williams; she co-founded a community nonprofit in 2008.
She has a bachelor's degree in business administration from Berkeley College and an MBA from the Metropolitan College of New York, and lives in East Flatbush.
